tagline: Credit limits, risk scoring, and payment reminders
problem: Sales confirms orders for customers who are already overdue or over credit limit.
solution: Credit Control scores partner risk, enforces limits, blocks risky orders, and automates WhatsApp payment reminders.

features.title: Risk Score
features.text: Weighted score from overdue, delay, and exposure.

features.title: Blocks
features.text: Stop confirm on critical risk partners.
